comment: The words that depend on the computer. Content files use these tokens, and resources.read_text puts in the words for the computer the app runs on (Windows or Mac). Every token must have both entries.

copy_path_hint.windows: In File Explorer you can right-click the file and choose Copy as path.
copy_path_hint.mac: In Finder you can select the file and press Option-Command-C to copy its path.

copy_path_action.windows: right-click the file in File Explorer, choose Copy as path
copy_path_action.mac: select the file in Finder, press Option-Command-C to copy its path
